source: Remaining docs/vi-p2-pool.json Tier B candidates plus seven existing raw-only TOEIC business pages named in the academic review; OALD 10 and LDOCE 6 were consulted locally as editorial references.
selectionRationale: Small exam-first batch: upgrade seven existing TOEIC/logistics/accounting pages and add five Tier B phrases useful for IELTS/TOEIC writing and business contexts. Dictionary entries informed sense boundaries, register and regional labels; all Vietnamese definitions, usage notes and bilingual examples in this batch are independently written.
